rows.title: Settings configure worktree root, setup-script path, run-setup automatically and open-after-create. Repository `.orbit/worktree.json` overrides root/script, not global booleans.
rows.baseline_behavior: Settings configure worktree root, setup-script path, run-setup automatically and open-after-create. Repository `.orbit/worktree.json` overrides root/script, not global booleans.
rows.baseline_edge_state: Global `~/.orbit-pi/worktrees.json`, defaults `.wt` and `.orbit/worktree-setup.sh`, auto-setup/open true. Absolute and `~/` paths supported. Missing/malformed config falls back safely; setup must be existing file.
rows.fixture: Temporary main repository and worktree root, isolated HOME, controlled setup script and no user repositories.

steps.action: Set global directory=.wt, setup_script=.orbit/worktree-setup.sh, run_setup_auto=false and open_after_create=false. Set repository .orbit/worktree.json directory=custom and setup_script=scripts/setup.sh.
steps.expected: Effective root/script use the repository values relative to main repository root. Both booleans remain false from global configuration; repository boolean keys do not override them.

steps.action: Reload settings and fail a save; repository overrides must not replace global booleans or falsely persist a toggled value.
steps.expected: Global `~/.orbit-pi/worktrees.json`, defaults `.wt` and `.orbit/worktree-setup.sh`, auto-setup/open true. Absolute and `~/` paths supported. Missing/malformed config falls back safely; setup must be existing file.

steps.action: Make ~/.orbit-pi/worktrees.json unwritable, then toggle automatic setup/open-after-create.
steps.expected: Rust changes live booleans and ignores persistence failure; Go transactionally retains prior config and exposes retryable error. Record this as deviation D05, not exact parity.

steps.action: Toggle a global worktree setting while a worktree list refresh is delayed.
steps.expected: A preference update does not create/move/remove a worktree. List loading cannot replace the changed preference; the settings control reflects actual successful persistence.

steps.action: Close/reopen with valid, missing and malformed ~/.orbit-pi/worktrees.json; separately corrupt repository .orbit/worktree.json.
steps.expected: Global keys are directory,setup_script,run_setup_auto,open_after_create,allowed_setup_repos. Missing/malformed global data uses source defaults; malformed repository overrides are ignored. Empty setup path disables setup rather than silently restoring default.

steps.action: Open Worktree settings, edit the text fields using Tab/Shift+Tab; cancel with Escape; reopen and save explicitly.
steps.expected: Cancel leaves saved config untouched; text editing does not dispatch Git/create commands. Exact source dialog focus order still needs matched native verification.

steps.action: Save the same config twice, switch repositories with different overrides and return.
steps.expected: No duplicate allowed-repository entries, no cross-repository override leakage and no hidden setup execution.
